# netcup_server_image_setup (Action)

Installs an image flavour on a netcup server (SCP REST API). **All data on the selected disk is lost.**

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "netcup_server_image_setup" "example" {
  config {
    server_id        = 12345
    image_flavour_id = 1
    disk_name        = "vda"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Optional

- `additional_user_password` (String) Password of the additional user. It cannot take an ephemeral value, so pass it through a `sensitive` variable. Prefer `ssh_key_ids`.
- `additional_user_username` (String) Name of an additional user.
- `custom_script` (String) Script to run during the setup.
- `disk_name` (String) Name of the disk, e.g. `vda`.
- `email_to_executing_user` (Boolean) Whether netcup sends an e-mail to the user.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the server.
- `image_flavour_id` (Number) Id of the flavour, from the `netcup_server_image_flavours` data source.
- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en_US.UTF-8`.
- `root_partition_full_disk_size` (Boolean) Whether the root partition takes the whole disk.
- `ssh_key_ids` (List of Number) Ids of the SSH keys to install.
- `ssh_password_authentication` (Boolean) Whether SSH accepts passwords.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `timezone` (String) Time zone, e.g. `Europe/Berlin`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `invoke` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
